body: Tested locally, it works as expected. Great work :slightly_smiling_face: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4f888949-2e0d-4569-a630-2131e4bdd43a Some feedback: - The outline width should be multiplied by `EDSCALE` to match other gizmo size increases (such as the manipulation gizmo). Right now, the outline looks pretty thin on hiDPI displays. - The outline is not affected by **Scaling 3D > Scale**, although it is affected by **Half Resolution** (note that https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/93436 would change this). - However, once you restart the editor, the outline *will* be affected by **Scaling 3D > Scale**. It'll look jagged if it was set below `1.0` before restarting the editor: The exact appearance of the jaggedness will depend on **Scaling 3D > Mode** too. - The outline is not affected by MSAA, screen-space AA or TAA/FSR2. I've tried to apply MSAA or SMAA to `selection_buffer_viewport` but it doesn't have intended effect, so I guess it would need additional shader changes to work. - If you have any node with an outline selected, I got a crash that's consistently reproducible in Truck Town's `town_scene.tscn` when using **Scene > Reload Saved Scene**: ``` ================================================================ handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.beta.custom_build (bb200ed70aaced4c3a38ff008e9c15b4aafb0d14) Dumping the backtrace.
